text_block_list.text: One day, Mayano Top Gun and I are summoned to the student council office…

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Whoa! You want me to be a guest at a fashion show?!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: That's correct. It's part of a PR event for the academy. The attendees voted on which signature racewear they'd like to see.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: The wedding signature racewear from the Beauty Dream Cup emerged victorious, so we called you here since you own it.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Eee! I love that outfit too! Wait a second. Doesn't that mean…

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: That's right. I, too, have the same outfit, so I'll be participating as well.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Furthermore, we also require that someone escort you down the runway as part of our vision.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: You can hold applications for fans or ask someone you know. Just let us know your decision by tomorrow.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Escorted by a fan… or someone I know, huh? Actually, I…

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: What do you think I should do, Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: I-if I walked with a fan, I'm sure they'd be really happy! Or I could ask Fuji. I'm sure she'd be really good at it…

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: But… if a certain someone were to ask me to pick them, then… Hmmm…

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Come on! Take the hint already!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Okay, fine! I guess I'll just come up with the best strategy to get through to you!
With that, I stand back and watch as Mayano Top Gun's strategy unfolds…

text_block_list.name: Younger Umamusume
text_block_list.text: Mayano! Everyone's dying to know who you picked to walk you down the runway!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Aw, thanks! I definitely have to find an applicant soon! Ahem…

text_block_list.name: Fan
text_block_list.text: I'm so excited for the event! I'd totally apply if fans were allowed to!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: I sure am popular, huh? ☆ If no one asks to walk me down the runway, I might just have to open applications to the public! Ahem…
A few days later, she still hasn't chosen an escort. As I'm wondering why…

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Pardon me. I've come to speak to you directly about a certain matter. I trust you're aware of which one, yes?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: I understand the gravity of this decision, but I can't wait forever. Please, I need an answer—
Stooop! Trainer, what's going on here?!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Escort role?! "I can't wait forever"?! Are you gonna be Air Groove's escort?!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: But… but… I've been waiting this whole time for you to ask me!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: You're my partner! I wanted you to ask me, not the other way around…

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: I've been waiting for you to say something, but now Air Groove's asked you?!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Wait a moment! What are talking about? I've already selected someone else to escort me.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: What?! Th-then… the reply for the escort role…
choice_data_list: She just wants to know who you've chosen.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: …Ohhh! I totally misread the situation then! Thank goodness.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Ha… Haha… Sorry for the misunderstanding. I thought my strategy of playing hard to get had totally failed…

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Oops!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Ugh… Fine! I thought that you'd see how popular I was, panic, and then ask me!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: I wanted to know… that you value me more than anyone else.
choice_data_list: Can you give me one more chance?
Of course I value you the most.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Hmph! You leave me no choice! Just one though!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: …Yaaay! Ehehe, I'm so happy!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: I'll go file the forms. Sigh… Please don't cause a ruckus the day of. Are we clear?

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Got it! I can't wait! The outfit is already perfect. All that's left is…

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Well, yeah, but I don't think my heart will ever stop pounding! I'll never be the same again…

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: I'm so happy! Let's make this an incredible fashion show, okay?
We walk out onto the runway full of excitement, and it ends up being a great success.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: R-really? I'm special? I'm the most precious? I twinkle the brightest?

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Ehehe! My plan may have failed, but I guess it all worked out in the end since I found out how you really feel about me!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Are you ready? I'm gonna make you say even more incredible things on the day! ☆

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Sigh… I'll go file the forms. I ask that you not cause any trouble on the day of the event, incredible or not.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Yay! ☆ Thanks for your support, everyone! I'm so happy!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: My trainer and I both promise to both keep on twinkling from here on out!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Right, Trainer? ♪
The crowd roars in response to this declaration, and the event ends in brilliant success!
